== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-collision-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Collision! (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. Same words.

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
